card.name: The start of the word Caucasians
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word Caucasians ("Caucas") when it follows "of" or "in" and a percentage, in drug-label statements about ethnic groups. It rarely fires on other stray words such as "tanker" or "discontent".

modes.label: Caucasians in percentages
modes.description: The start of Caucasians after a percentage and "of" or "in", often in poor-metabolizer statements.
modes.example: Approximately 7 to 10% of<< Caucas>>ians and 3 to 8%

modes.label: Caucasians among other groups
modes.description: The start of Caucasians when listed alongside other racial or ethnic groups.
modes.example: 1 to 10% in<< Caucas>>ians, 3% in African Americans

modes.label: Stray other words
modes.description: Occasional weak hits on unrelated words such as tanker or discontent.
modes.example: of<< discontent>>. However, the Americans forced Burgoy
